subject: Thanks for joining us!
text:
Hey [NAME],

Thanks for joining us the other day. Did I hear correctly that you were
given 2 free robots from someone at our table??

Conversation was as good as the food so I just wanted to send that thankyou
over. I know my colleague [SENDER] was the original contact at Encord so I
thought i'd check in and see if you had any time in the next week or so to
exchange thoughts on what both companies are doing?

All the best and see you at the next one!

subject: Re: Invite to Execs AI Roundtable dinner - Nvidia GTC - 17th March
text:
Hi [NAME],

Big fans of [COMPANY] - you've been on our radar (pun intended) for some time as
we're talking to Archer and Joby in regard to supporting their autonomous
eVTOL systems.

My co-founder, [SENDER], is hosting a dinner in San Jose on the 17th of March
for ~20 leaders in AI and Autonomy, and we'd love for you to join if you're
going to be in the South Bay for Nvidia GTC.

If Encord is new to you, we just raised our Series C to further support
physical AI customers with our multimodal ML DataOps platform - we work
with companies like Maxar, Woven by Toyota and Phantom AI on their
geospatial and scaling their data pipelines.

Dinner will be in a private room at BE.STEAK.A from 6pm, a short walk from
the venue, with founders and Heads of AI from companies like Waymo,
Outrider, Wisk and more

Would you be interested in joining? If so, I'll send over the full details.

subject: Re: Physical AI Leaders Dinner - 17th March
text:

Excited to see what you're building at Elevate - especially as we've been
speaking with Lomesh's team at Apptronik, which naturally makes me curious
about what you're working on as well.

We're hosting a Physical AI dinner in San Jose on the 17th of March
(alongside Nvidia GTC) for ~20 leaders in AI and Autonomy, and we'd love
for you to join if you're interest.

For context, Encord just announced our Series C to further support physical
AI teams with our multimodal ML DataOps platform - we work with 1X, Boston
Dynamics, Dyna and others on VLA/VLMs, and world model workflows.

Dinner will be in a private room at BE.STEAK.A from 6pm, a short walk from
the venue, with founders and Heads of AI from our network.

Would you be interested in joining? If so, I'll send over the full details.

subject: Encord Reconnect
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] mentioned you were looking to systematize metadata enrichment
and quality review processes across video, audio and captions. -- thought
it's worth reconnecting!

We transitioned a few teams working on long-form video annotation and
transcription from legacy setups; primarily for more advanced
pre-labelling capabilities and more consistent workflow orchestration.

How's next week looking for a catch up? We're flexible morning times CT.

subject: [Invite] AI Leaders Dinner @ GTC - Mar 17
text:
Hi 
       [NAME], 

       Hope you've been well! I thought you might be going to NVIDIA GTC next month, and wanted to invite you to an exclusive dinner we're hosting for AI leaders in 
       San Jose on Tuesday, Mar 17 at Be.Steak.A. 

       It'll be an intimate event with ~30 founders and senior execs to step away from the crowds at GTC, and connect in a relaxed setting over good food and drinks.

       For context, Encord supports teams like Boston Dynamics, Physical Intelligence, Thinking Machines Lab, and Woven (Toyota) on advanced CV and multimodal AI pipelines. 

       I'd love to save a seat for you - will you be in San Jose that night?
